purpose: Actual incident contexts with AI-assisted candidate contrasts awaiting independent relevance review. No model predictions or approved labels.
partitionPolicy: All three canonical documents and their translations/variants are reserved for held_out. Do not use them for model training, prompt tuning or development. Pretrained corpus independence is unknown.
limitations: Historical investigations are not current jurisdictional legal certification.
Only three US incident contexts; not representative of all 18 Locales or all hazards.
Proposed labels and contrast rationales are editorial inferences, not quotations or expert approval.
